correctness.rationale: An exact graph-distance lemma gives the three-letter cyclic-word constraints. The weighted five-state transfer matrix has determinant 1-x-2ux^3-u^2x^4-u^2x^5. Its trace identity and a separate cyclic-gap proof give all coefficients. A parity argument proves the three residue regimes, and the known Roman bijection plus cubic regularity yields weight 2n-2k. The standalone verifier checks the exact determinant, original graph packings through n=12, complete ternary Roman conditions through n=6, recurrence through n=60 and extrema through n=100. Infinite validity comes from proof rather than finite tests.

value.rationale: The all-cardinality profile of closed-neighborhood-disjoint two-packings is a natural invariant for an infinite family of cubic graphs. The mod-4 obstruction changes the maximum packing size and changes the number of optimal configurations from 2n to 4 to n(n-2). This also determines the complete distribution of unique-response Roman weights and all minimizers, not only a minimum number. The exact enumerator is not a renaming or normalization of an earlier result.
